The '''''Pride of Stars''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its early [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the decorated [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Ran Niall]], who implicitly trusted his [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] crew.<ref name="OaAI" />

At one point, the ''Pride of Stars'' visited the Imperial [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|shipyards]] in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] for routine maintenance and crew leave. During his leave on the planet's surface, Niall witnessed Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Massacre on Mon Cala|executing]] a group of protesting local shopkeepers, an event that shook the captain to his core and made him vow to find a more honorable government on whose behalf to fight. While the ''Pride of Stars'' was undergoing repairs, Niall decided to strike out with the vessel, and his crew did not hesitate to join his rebellion. Niall eventually became a [[General/Legends|general]] with a [[Ardan resistance|resistance group]] based on the planet [[Arda I]], although the ''Pride of Stars'' itself was at one point scuttled by [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from an Imperial [[assault corvette]].<ref name="OaAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pride of Stars'' was mentioned in the [[2014]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', published for use with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] system.<ref name="OaAI" />
